status: PRE-REGISTERED, sealed in the harness-v1.1 commit before any corpus-v2 candidate was screened. Draw with: backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe scripts/draw_corpus.py draw-v2
purpose: Pre-registered sampling rule for RERUN's second Batch Lab corpus. It fixes corpus-v1's post-draw finding (E5 accepted install/download/preprocessing/setup steps and unfilled placeholders as the 'run command') BEFORE any corpus-v2 candidate is screened.

relation_to_corpus_v1.datasets_frame_population: identical to corpus-v1 (backend/app/batch/corpus_v1/prereg.json): same pwc-archive revisions, frame regexes and population.csv
relation_to_corpus_v1.changed: E5 only (E5_v2 below), and a new seed
relation_to_corpus_v1.excludes_corpus_v1: papers AND repositories already in corpus-v1 (its 20 paper_url and repo_url values) are skipped as duplicates and logged, so corpus-v2 is a fresh sample

eligibility.E5_v2_documented_run_command: Same README search, candidate extraction, target-existence check and placeholder_regex as corpus-v1 E5, with ONE added exclusion applied to every candidate line before the existence check: a line is skipped if backend/app/batch/command_rules.py::matched_rules(line) is non-empty (any of R1_INSTALL, R2_DOWNLOAD, R3_PREPROCESS, R4_SETUP_SCRIPT, R5_PLACEHOLDER). The FIRST REMAINING line, in reading order, whose script/module exists at the pinned commit is recorded verbatim as the corpus command.

exclusion_rules.implementation: backend/app/batch/command_rules.py::matched_rules (corpus-v1 amendment-1 rules, unchanged), as sealed in the harness-v1.1 commit; draw-v2 refuses to run if any regex there differs from this file
exclusion_rules.stem: script file name without extension, or a python -m module's last dotted component; stem regexes IGNORECASE
exclusion_rules.args: shell-split words after the runnable target; arg regexes case-sensitive

eligibility.not_required: CPU feasibility, runtime, data availability — measured by RERUN, not screened (as corpus-v1).
eligibility.known_limitation: Only the root README is searched (as corpus-v1). A README whose only run commands are excluded makes the paper ineligible (E5_v2 fail), which shifts the sample toward repos documenting a direct run command; reported, not corrected.

seed_note: The registration date, the same convention as corpus-v1's 20260924. Fixed before any corpus-v2 draw.
draw_procedure: random.Random(20260928).shuffle(list(range(len(population)))) in CPython; screen in that order with E3, E4, E5_v2; a paper or repository already in corpus-v1, or a repository already drawn for another paper, is skipped as a duplicate; stop at 20 eligible or when the population is exhausted (then report the achieved N). No manual exclusions or replacements; every draw is logged with its pass/fail reason in corpus_v2/screening_log.jsonl.
analysis: All drawn entries are the primary endpoint (every recorded command is a run command by construction). The batch runs on a frozen harness tag recorded in every run record; any analysis change is a numbered amendment committed before the batch starts.
draw_script: scripts/draw_corpus.py draw-v2 (sealed with this file). It refuses to draw unless sha256(prereg.json) equals corpus_v2/prereg.sha256, population.csv matches population_sha256, and its E5 regexes and command_rules' exclusion regexes equal this file's.
corpus_hash_definition: sha256 of canonical JSON {prereg_sha256, entries sorted by name with name, repo_url, commit_sha, command} (as corpus-v1)
harness: The corpus-v2 batch runs on the harness-v1.1 tag with no harness change. A harness bug found by corpus-v2 is recorded, not fixed; the batch stops.
